definitions.explanation: A track and field event in which athletes sprint and jump as far as possible into a sand pit.

examples.japanese: {走|はし}り{幅跳|はばと}び⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{八|はち}→八：00698_hachi⟧⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧⟦{跳|と}んだ→跳ぶ：19597_tobu⟧。
examples.english: He jumped eight meters in long jump.

examples.japanese: {走|はし}り{幅跳|はばと}び⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{助走|じょそう}→助走：15506_josou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スピード→スピード：11048_supiido⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: In long jump, the speed of the approach run is important.

examples.japanese: {走|はし}り{幅跳|はばと}び⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{県大会|けんたいかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出場|しゅつじょう}した→出場する：20348_shutsujousuru⟧。
examples.english: I competed in long jump at the prefectural tournament.

notes:
{走|はし}り{幅跳|はばと}び is the long jump — a track and field event where athletes sprint down a runway and jump as far as possible into a sand pit.

COMMON ABBREVIATION:
Often shortened to {幅跳|はばと}び (broad jump) in casual contexts.

RULES:
Athletes must take off before a foul line ({踏|ふ}み{切|き}り⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧) and land in a sand pit (⟦{砂場|すなば}→砂場：06326_sunaba⟧). Distance is measured from the foul line to the nearest mark in the sand.
